finalText:
Build's clean — exit 0, 0 errors. The remaining 8 warnings are just Node deprecation noise from the bump (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc.), not blocking anything.

Two real bugs from the dependency bump, both call sites that missed the new bundler API shape:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the bumped bundler now hands options as `{ retryCount }` instead of `{ retries }`; `resolveRetries` was still reading `options.retries`, which was `undefined`, so `.toFixed(0)` threw.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`; `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted explicit `true`/`false` and threw on `undefined`. Now `undefined` is treated as disabled.
